label: bisect no-progress break removed
equivalent: The break only stops iterating once no float lies strictly between lo and hi. Under bisect's contract, below(lo) holds and below(hi) does not, every later pass computes m equal to lo (below true, lo = m: no change) or to hi (below false, hi = m: no change), so the result is the same bits, only later. Every caller meets the contract: roots bisects towards the sign found at the bracket's lower end, both crossing searches start from a voltage below threshold (idle cells are below 1 at every step start), and eq. (11)'s q is below beta > 0 at every point the search visits.
